# Verity National

> Acid-free boxes, sleeves and albums for family papers and photographs. Archival storage supplies posted to every part of the UK from York, England.

Verity National sells acid-free, lignin-free lidded boxes (A4 and foolscap), clear polyester photo sleeves (6x4 in and 10x8 in), buffered tissue, a slip-in album with archival pages, document wallets and a family papers starter kit. Prices are in GBP on every page. It sells supplies only: no scanning, no valuation, no family-history research, no treatment of damaged items.
